features.name: Ink Canvas Tactile Feedback
features.note: Scenario entirely dropped from the WinUI nav (SampleConfiguration.cs registers only 4 scenarios; listed in MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md as 'unsupported-only'). UWP shows an InkCanvas + pen toolbar; WinUI has no such page (nav to title fails, lands on Query Tactile Feedback Support). InkCanvas IS supported in WinUI 3, so this is a genuine missing feature.

features.name: Query Tactile Feedback Support
features.note: Renders faithfully; description text matches UWP golden.

features.name: Inking Feedback
features.note: Waveform ComboBox (InkContinuous), Intensity slider, and inking canvas area all present and visually match UWP.

features.name: Interaction Feedback
features.note: 'Send Interaction Feedback' button confirmed present via live UIA inspect (sendFeedback) along with waveform ComboBox + Intensity slider. Compare-Parity marked FAIL only due to title-ambiguous nav ('Interaction Feedback' also matches 'Inking and Interaction Feedback'), a capture artifact. Button is hardware-gated (no haptic pen) and produced no response in BOTH UWP golden and WinUI, so no behavioral regression.

features.name: Inking and Interaction Feedback
features.note: Draggable blue square on a grid matches UWP golden exactly (position, grid, colors).
